temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks if something is wrong, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging and sociable, so her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and potentially concerning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn confirms that her quietness is due to feeling overwhelmed by work and personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling with stress and personal matters, and may need support or someone to talk to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support, listen, and check in on Marilyn without pressuring her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a subsequent interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. When Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and hope that she did not overstep, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn's curt response may mean Carolyn overstepped or that Marilyn is upset with her, creating confusion and hurt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness was likely due to a hard week rather than personal rejection, and she appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The misunderstanding seems cleared; Marilyn is receptive to Carolyn's support, and their communication can remain supportive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Confused and hurt, then relieved and comforted
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear misunderstandings, show support, and maintain open communication with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn appeared to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. When Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about their budding friendship after Marilyn responded positively to her openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's acceptance of the invitation confirms that she is open to connecting socially and strengthening the relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in building a friendship, and their bond may grow stronger outside of work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Host the small gathering and strengthen her friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still maintains a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn directly asks about their work dynamic, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have been developing a friendship, but she perceives Marilyn as deliberately or confusingly distant at work, which disappoints her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn did not intend to create distance and is willing to discuss and improve their professional collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The work distance may be unintentional and addressable; their professional relationship can improve through direct conversation.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address their work dynamic directly and work toward better collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. When she proposes teaming up for a new project, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have resolved their work-dynamic issues and now understand each other better. She feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn is enthusiastic about collaborating and values their improved understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is stronger, and working together on the new project should be positive and productive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and continue building their collaborative partnership.
